title: Student Preferences in Interacting with AI-Enhanced Learning Assistants (AIELA): A Comparative Study
description: The study compared a Raspberry Pi learning assistant with a web version students could use on their own devices. After two classroom demonstrations, students described where they still wanted a person’s help.

title: Enhancing CS Education with LAs Using AI-Empowered AIELA Program
description: The spring 2024 pilot examined weekly team activities in two computer science courses. The research team collected reflections from students and learning assistants and tested an early chatbot that could ask follow-up questions.

title: A Survey and Comparison of Secure Software Development Standards
venue: 13th CMI Conference on Cybersecurity and Privacy – Digital Transformation – Potentials and Challenges
description: During my master’s studies, I worked with Armando Ramirez and Susan J. Lincke to compare published standards for developing secure software. This was the subject I had chosen to concentrate on in my MS CIS.
